SEARCH
Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable coupled sulfur, nitrogen, hydrogen, hydrogen-sulfide, and ammonia balance receipt.

The receipt solves sulfur and nitrogen targets on one calculated liquid-product mass. It is limited to stoichiometric bookkeeping and does not predict reaction pathways, kinetics, catalyst performance, operating conditions, heat duty, hydrocarbon yield, or compliance.

Version:
1.0
Author:
esolbr1

    • calculate

      public static RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenBalance calculate(double feedMassKg, double feedSulfurMassFraction, double feedNitrogenMassFraction, double targetProductSulfurMassFraction, double targetProductNitrogenMassFraction, double hydrogenMolesPerSulfurMole, double hydrogenMolesPerNitrogenMole)
      Calculate a coupled sulfur and nitrogen hydrotreating material-balance receipt.
      Parameters:
      feedMassKg - feed mass in kilograms
      feedSulfurMassFraction - sulfur mass fraction in the feed
      feedNitrogenMassFraction - total-nitrogen mass fraction in the feed
      targetProductSulfurMassFraction - requested sulfur mass fraction on product mass
      targetProductNitrogenMassFraction - requested nitrogen mass fraction on product mass
      hydrogenMolesPerSulfurMole - moles of H2 consumed per mole of sulfur removed; at least one
      hydrogenMolesPerNitrogenMole - moles of H2 consumed per mole of nitrogen removed; at least 1.5
      Returns:
      immutable coupled balance receipt

    • calculateForAssay

      public static RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenBalance calculateForAssay(double feedMassKg, OilAssayCharacterisation assay, double targetProductSulfurMassFraction, double targetProductNitrogenMassFraction, double hydrogenMolesPerSulfurMole, double hydrogenMolesPerNitrogenMole)
      Calculate a coupled receipt using bulk sulfur and nitrogen reconstructed by an oil assay.
      Parameters:
      feedMassKg - feed mass in kilograms
      assay - oil assay providing bulk sulfur and nitrogen mass fractions
      targetProductSulfurMassFraction - requested sulfur mass fraction on product mass
      targetProductNitrogenMassFraction - requested nitrogen mass fraction on product mass
      hydrogenMolesPerSulfurMole - moles of H2 consumed per mole of sulfur removed
      hydrogenMolesPerNitrogenMole - moles of H2 consumed per mole of nitrogen removed
      Returns:
      immutable coupled balance receipt
